correctness.rationale: Bijective weak-composition representation gives one- and two-gap exact probabilities. Their exact covariance has a controlled first-order asymptotic expansion with a strictly positive prefactor multiplying negative quadratic Q. A discriminant criterion and integer minimization identify unique shortest pair (1,9). Three all-t polynomial factorizations prove (-,+,-) for every t>=10. Standalone finite checker passes 1292 exact assertions; proof covers infinite claims independently.

value.rationale: The pairwise covariance structure of exact maximal-run frequencies matters for multivariate fixed-margin run tests. A quadratic all-pair phase kernel and the globally minimal strict reentrant pair identify a structural dependence boundary. A rigorous infinite sequence of finite (-,+,-) sign reversals shows dependence not captured by a blanket negative correlation heuristic, not merely a small finite-table curiosity.
